events.title: Housing Action Plan Discussion

votes.name: Emily Francis
votes.rationale_summary: Supported the Housing Action Plan as a guiding document for housing strategy.

votes.name: Chris Conway
votes.rationale_summary: Agreed with the need to continue focusing on housing supply and incorporating activities from the Affordable and Sustainable Growth Initiative (Ad Hoc Committee).

votes.name: Julie Pignataro
votes.rationale_summary: Acknowledged challenges for developers producing units affordable to households at 50% AMI and below.

votes.name: Josh Fudge
votes.rationale_summary: Supported the development of strategies that support structured affordable housing products, specifically those projects filling the largest affordability gaps (under 50% AMI for rentals and under 100% AMI for homeownership).

votes.name: Melanie Potyondy
votes.rationale_summary: Agreed with the need to maintain existing affordable housing stock and support development of natural affordable housing.

votes.name: Amy Hoeven
votes.rationale_summary: Was absent from the discussion, but supported the Housing Action Plan as a guiding document for housing strategy.
